mutations.description: The orphan test is inverted: live personas are swept and orphans are kept

baseDefects.description: The orphan sweep treats a persona missing from the open database as gone for good and deletes its saved sign-in, but a restore of a newer backup or a first start on an empty database file brings the persona back with its sign-in already destroyed (maintainer ruling 2026-09-28 on the Opus 5.5 dispatch-mode run)
